sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 4 August 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000069-P1 was put before Summit Wellness Center 069 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 4.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Tdap minimum take of 510 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
